note: Both sets cover essentially the same claims with the same values, conditions, and supporting quotes, including the peak power coefficient with its tip-speed ratio, pitch angle, and 8 m/s wind speed conditions, and the Region 1½/2½ transition definitions. Differences are only in wording of entity labels (e.g., 'generator-slip' vs 'generator | slip percentage', 'generator speed' vs 'generator | transitional speed') and quote truncation for the gearbox ratio, none of which affect correctness. Both contain the same minor redundancy (the Region 3 inverse-proportionality claim stated twice) and the same debatable 'time domain' condition on the filter roll-off, so neither is favored.
